description: Lets Jev (TypeSafe) pick at most one skill per prompt from the installed skills' descriptions, instead of the model reading all of their listings on every prompt. Two Jev stages (rank every skill + gate, then re-read the top three with their SKILL.md and one fits noul each) plus the current Orca worktree/project/branch in the state. Starts in measurement mode: nothing observable changes, only a JSONL record per prompt. Active mode (withhold the listing, inject the winner) is off until that data sets its thresholds.
